claims.text: Plurality plays a major role in predicting referential choice, as it influences how referents are treated in discourse, particularly when conjoined noun phrases are introduced.
Including the plurality feature in prediction tasks may facilitate pronoun detection, suggesting a direct relationship between plurality and referential form.
Inherent features of a referent, including plurality, are crucial in determining the choice of referential form, alongside grammatical role and antecedent form.
